title: 🔗 Two Sorted Chains
description: ✨ Merge two sorted lists into one perfectly ordered chain.

title: 🫥 Both Lists Empty
description: 🌌 With nothing in either list, the merged chain remains empty.

title: ➡️ First List Empty
description: 🎯 When the first list is empty, the second list forms the result.

title: ⬅️ Second List Empty
description: 🎯 When the second list is empty, the first list remains unchanged.

title: 🔁 Duplicate Values
description: 🔄 Preserve every node, including values that appear multiple times.

title: ❄️ Negative & Positive Values
description: ⚖️ Merge values spanning negative, zero, and positive numbers.

title: 📏 Unequal Lengths
description: 🧩 Combine lists of different lengths while keeping everything sorted.

title: 🎯 Identical Lists
description: 🔗 Merge two identical sorted chains without losing any nodes.
